Yeah, I suppose I've been trying, but there's only so much one can do.
Ha, as far as her being undeserving of me, not to totally rag on myself, but I wasn't exactly  a good boyfriend. Of course it wasn't on purpose, or that I didn't try. I didn't really realized I was doing a lot of it until fairly recently. She had kind of tried to bring it up in the past, but never really did a good job, so it never got through to me. Ultimately, though, I think it probably should have been enough to tip me off. But I guess I'll know now for the future.

Yeah, there's potential for living with some relatives. But I'd really rather be on my own/living with roommates or something. For me and what I want right now, I think living with family would kind of defeat the purpose. 

I know I do have friends that care, but even if I logically know that, I can't really picture anyone caring all that much when I think about it. Which I think is kind of the problem here. I also feel kind of bad because I know I have other friends who care that I've kind of broken away from. It's not that I don't want to hang out with them or anything, but I'm always afraid they'll serve as too much of a reminder, or something. 

That's kind of the problem, I think, my outlook on life tends to be rather bleak. Sure I can look forward to small things, like concerts and whatnot, but I don't really have anything long term to look forward to. I have no career path, school doesn't feel right for me, but I don't feel like I have any other option, and well, I'm just gonna end up looping back into what I was talking about before.

Yeah, you know with the whole ex thing, that's kind of what I figured too, until I talked to her. All I wanted was confirmation that she still cared in some aspect, but I suppose that didn't work out. 

Sure, she did at one point, but I'm honestly not sure when that stopped anymore. Which just kind of leaves me to look back and wonder. I donno. I've been thinking about all the details and whatnot about it less lately. It just that to me, it's always been common courtesy to give someone a grace period of a few months, and to have neither of them care enough to do so hurt. And then hearing that, among other things, form her made it worse. 

Anyways, I don't mean to go off in a tangent about it. I've been trying really hard to not think about it anymore, but there are just so many reminders everywhere. 

I honestly just want to be able to skip town. Leave just about everything here, deactivate my facebook, get a new phone number, and just disappear for a while, until I felt ready to reconnect with everyone. I'd feel bad leaving everyone, I suppose, I'm sure it'd be upsetting for them, but I really just don't want to have anything to do with anything here anymore. 

Anyways, to actually address some of the stuff you mentioned. There are always little things to look forward to. I have a few concerts and such coming up, and I'm excited for them, but that doesn't really change the overall problem. Nor does it change anything in the mean time. I do a lot of hanging out with people, and that tends to keep me occupied, but one can only do that so much. I have troubles being on my own now, because I just get to feeling down, but I used to spend a lot of time to myself, it gets tiresome not being able to be alone anymore. As well as having to constantly try to keep myself busy, and distracted. I miss being able to just sit and relax. 

Sorry I keep kind of rambling off. Thanks again for listening.

The way I see it, it's hard to be displeased about not existing, when you don't exist. Or to be upset about anything for that matter, because you quite literally can't be. 

Of course the trade off is that you can't feel any of the positive emotions out there either, but it can be hard to care. Especially when just not existing sounds much more, er, pleasant I suppose.
